messages.text: I have been waiting almost 3 weeks for a reply from Abel?
Handed to the team · Customer is chasing an unanswered thread with Abel; no identifiers given yet.

I'm sorry, three weeks without an answer isn't good enough. I've pinged the team and one of them will jump into this chat, so stay here if you can, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

So I can pick it up in the meantime, what's the order number, or the email you wrote from? And what was the question to Abel about?
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the order-swap skill
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · Return completed Sep 24, nothing issued back; credit history not readable from r

Thanks, I've got you. Two things sit open on your side: the NerdQaxe++ you sent back reached our Tennessee warehouse on September 24 and nothing has gone back out to you since, and on Shop···· the Overclocking add-on is still waiting on stock.

Which of those were you chasing Abel about? I've pinged the team again with both, so stay in the chat and someone will jump in here.
The R., was supposed to be upgraded to a T40 and an extra $100.00 off.
Handed to the team · Customer reports an agreement with Abel that is not recorded on the order; a pro

That upgrade and the $100 aren't written on the order, so I can't set them up myself without Abel confirming the terms. I've put it straight to him and Georges with your words on it, so stay in this chat and one of them will come in here; if you step away it comes to your email.

For the record, the Magic Miner 40T is a pre-sale unit, $799, ships November 14. Sorry you've been sitting on this since September.
No invoice yet, so I can lock it in before it sells out, again.
Read the magic miner 40t page

The 40T is open right now, Batch 7 at $799, so there's a slot there today. What I can't do is raise the invoice with the $100 on it until Abel confirms that deal, and I don't want to bill you the wrong amount.

He and Georges have it with your words attached. Stay in the chat and one of them will come in; if you step away it reaches your email.
You told me the same thing last week, and no one ever replied.
Used the order-swap skill

You're right, and I'm sorry. Your unit has been with us since September 24 and nothing has gone back out. That's on us, not on you.

The difference now is the team is on shift and this is sitting in front of Abel and Georges with your $100 and the 40T spelled out.

One question so you're not stuck either way: if Abel can't confirm the $100 today, do you want me to get the straight replacement moving instead?

You told me he was in last time also, and he still did not reply.  And I would like to do the upgrade, but I would also like a response.  On Trust Pilot I was told I would get a reply, earlier this week, still nothing.
Handed to the team · Third chase; previous flags and a Trustpilot reply promise went unanswered. Need

I won't tell you again that someone is about to reply, since that hasn't been worth much to you. What I've done is put it in front of Abel and Georges as a chase, with the Trustpilot promise and the three weeks in it, named as yours to answer today.

The upgrade itself I can run the moment the $100 is confirmed, and I'll stay on this chat with you while we wait.
Sarah is the one that replied to me on Trust Pilot.

Then that was me, and I'm the one who didn't come good on it. I'm sorry, that's a poor way to treat someone who's been waiting since September.

So I'm not repeating it. The chase is logged against Abel and Georges now, and I'll stay in this chat with you. Whatever comes back, you also get this whole conversation in writing at your email once we're done here.
Thank you.

Thanks for being patient with it, Robert. I'm here if you want to keep the chat open while we wait.

One thing that'll help when Abel picks this up: was the 40T meant to replace the NerdQaxe++ spot entirely, or go alongside the Thor P2 you already have running?
lol, I am Raland

Noted, Raland. My mistake, I read it off the email.

Same question stands though: is the 40T taking the NerdQaxe++'s place, or running alongside the Thor P2?
Replace

Got it, straight replacement. I've put that on the ticket so Abel sees exactly what he's confirming: the 40T in place of the NerdQaxe++ that's back with us, with the $100 he agreed.

I'll stay here with you while that comes back.
He is the one that sent the email telling me $100.00 off.

I believe you. It isn't on the order record here, which is the only reason I can't bill it myself.

Quickest way to close that gap: paste the line from Abel's email here, with the date it came. That goes on the ticket next to your name and Abel just has to say yes, rather than go digging.

From: Abel — HeliumDeploy <(email hidden)>
Sent: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 9:27 PM
To: (email hidden) <(email hidden)>
Cc: (email hidden) <(email hidden)>; (email hidden) <(email hidden)>
Subject: Re: RMA possible upgrade
 
Hey Raland, Abel stepping in from Helium Deploy we can give $100 off the Magic T if you want it. We'll send you a draft order for it for the RMA situation
Handed to the team · Customer produced Abel's email; the draft order with the $100 off was never sent

That's exactly what was needed. It's on the ticket word for word now, with the date and the cc list, so Abel confirms rather than digs.

What you're waiting on is the draft order he described: the Magic Miner 40T with the $100 off, in place of the NerdQaxe++ we have here. The 40T is Batch 7, $799 before that $100, ships November 14.

I'll stay with you here.
Yes, so I can lock it in.

Understood. Batch 7 is open and selling right now, so there's a slot today, and the draft order from Abel is what holds yours.

That's with him as a live chase. I'm not going to put a time on his reply after this week, but I'm watching this chat, and if anything moves I'll tell you here. The full conversation also lands in your inbox when we close.
I just noticed how much is a T4 bundle for the same price?
Searched the catalog · bundle

Good catch. The M. MINER 40T PACK is the same $799 as the bare 40T, and it includes a free Power Kit and Miner Duster (listed value $908.98). Same machine, same Batch 7 ship date of November 14.

https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t-pack-free-power-kit-miner-duster

Want me to put that on the ticket as the one you'd like Abel's $100 applied to, instead of the plain 40T?
Yes
Handed to the team · Customer picked the bundle SKU; draft order with Abel's $100 off still needs rai

Done, that's on the ticket now: the 40T PACK with the US cable, $799, less Abel's $100, as the replacement for the NerdQaxe++ we're holding. Nothing else for you to do on it.

If anything about that choice changes before he raises the draft, tell me here and I'll amend it.
What time do you leave for the day, and which time zone?

I'm here around the clock, so you can message me any time.

The team, Abel and Georges, work 10am to 6pm Eastern, Monday to Friday. It's 4:27pm Eastern now, so there's about an hour and a half left of their day.
Thank you.
You're welcome, Raland. I'll keep an eye on this one, and the full conversation reaches your email once we close here.
How long has it been since you pinged him?

About two hours since the first one, and just over an hour since I added the 40T PACK detail. It's 5:21 Eastern, so there's about forty minutes of their day left.

If nothing comes back before six, it carries into tomorrow morning at 10am Eastern, and the reply reaches your email either way.
